g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each point is the share of losses planted in the real power of 5 solar farms, with onsets from April to September, that a monitor flagged within 28 days. Bars: 95% interval from resampling the 5 farms. Dashed line: the 80% the plan required. Each monitor is tuned to about 0.35 false alarms per farm-year.'

text.tspan: Each point is the share of losses planted in the real power of 5 solar farms, with onsets from April to
September, that a monitor flagged within 28 days. Bars: 95% interval from resampling the 5 farms. Dashed
line: the 80% the plan required. Each monitor is tuned to about 0.35 false alarms per farm-year.
